audio.text: You're not still working on that lab report, are you?

options: The lab is on the third floor of the science building.
I'm afraid so. The data took forever to sort out.
No, I don't report to anyone at my job.
I work at the café most weekends.

why.en: Indirect "yes": "I'm afraid so" confirms she is still working on it, and she adds a reason. C repeats "report" with a different meaning; A answers "where"; D repeats "work".
why.tr: Dolaylı "evet": "I'm afraid so" hâlâ üzerinde çalıştığını doğruluyor ve bir sebep ekliyor. C "report" kelimesini farklı anlamda tekrarlıyor; A "where" sorusunu cevaplıyor; D "work" kelimesini tekrarlıyor.
why.es: "Sí" indirecto: "I'm afraid so" confirma que sigue trabajando en él y añade un motivo. C repite "report" con otro significado; A responde a "where"; D repite "work".
